summary: Starwood Property Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $600 million aggregate principal amount of 6.125% unsecured senior notes due 2031 under an indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon as trustee. The notes were privately placed to QIBs and non-U.S. persons, with net proceeds allocated to eligible green/social projects and to repay $400 million of 3.625% Senior Notes due 2026 plus general corporate purposes including repurchase facility debt. This is an ordinary debt financing, not a special situation.
